name: Sorrow Hill Crypt
summary: Tucked away on the eastern edge of Sorrow Hill's vast graveyard, this dilapidated crypt houses lingering remnants of the Scourge. Its dark subterranean chambers crawl with skeletal magi and warders guarding forgotten tombs and an eerie underground study.

sections.title: A Desecrated Vault
sections.body: Sorrow Hill serves as the sprawling final resting place for countless victims of the Third War and the plague that razed Lordaeron. On its eastern border, a stone crypt descends beneath the ruined cemetery soil. Rather than peaceful rest, the subterranean vault crawl with skeletal spellcasters and Scourge sentries. Deep at the lowest level lies a subterranean study complete with desks, bookcases, and scattered tomes—suggesting the crypt served as a secluded redoubt or laboratory for the Cult of the Damned operating around Andorhal.

faq.q: What is inside the Sorrow Hill Crypt?
faq.answer: The crypt is occupied by undead defenders, including skeletal magi and Scourge warders. At the lowest level, beyond the burial vaults, sits an intact underground workspace with a desk, bookshelves, and piles of neglected books.

Some travelers speculate this crypt might have held Kel'Thuzad's original remains after Prince Arthas slew him, due to its proximity to Andorhal. However, historical accounts place his death and temporary burial northeast of the city rather than southeast here at Sorrow Hill.

faq.q: Who used the underground office in the crypt?
aliases: who owns the desk in the crypt
faq.answer: The specific owner is unrecorded, but the books, desk, and surrounding skeletal guardians point toward necromancers of the Cult of the Damned or Scourge overseers using the desecrated vault as a hidden sanctuary.

aliases: how to find sorrow hill crypt
faq.answer: You can find it on the eastern side of the Sorrow Hill graveyard in the southern reaches of the Western Plaguelands, just south of the ruined city of Andorhal.

angles.text: The desecration of consecrated burial grounds at Sorrow Hill serves as a bitter reminder of the Scourge's total disregard for the sanctity of the dead.
Laying close to Uther the Lightbringer's resting place, this infested crypt is another painful mark on the fallen kingdom of Lordaeron that Alliance travelers seek to cleanse.
